sql: WITH RECURSIVE years(y) AS (SELECT cast(substr(min(term_start),1,4) as int) FROM legislators_terms UNION ALL SELECT y+1 FROM years WHERE y< (SELECT cast(substr(max(term_end),1,4) as int) FROM legislators_terms)),r AS (SELECT *,row_number() over(partition by id_bioguide order by term_start,term_number,term_id) rn FROM legislators_terms),cohort AS (SELECT r.id_bioguide,r.term_start first_start FROM r JOIN legislators l USING(id_bioguide) WHERE rn=1 AND state='LA' AND gender='M'),active AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.id_bioguide,c.first_start,printf('%04d-12-31',y) snapshot,y-cast(substr(c.first_start,1,4) as int) period FROM cohort c JOIN legislators_terms t USING(id_bioguide) JOIN years ON printf('%04d-12-31',y) BETWEEN t.term_start AND t.term_end) SELECT a.period,a.id_bioguide,l.full_name,l.gender,a.first_start,a.snapshot,t.state,t.term_start,t.term_end FROM active a JOIN legislators l USING(id_bioguide) JOIN legislators_terms t ON t.id_bioguide=a.id_bioguide AND a.snapshot BETWEEN t.term_start AND t.term_end WHERE period=31 ORDER BY a.id_bioguide
